sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dry, spasmodic cough. I.arynx con-
stricted, with stinging in fauces. Trachea feels sore
when pressed. Hoarseness and chronic laryngeal affec-
tions of public speakers

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Urine colorless. Deposits white sediment;
urine milky and thick

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Aching pains in bones of extremities
and back.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Ulcers; chronic eruptions on hands and
fingers. Enlarged cervical glands. Burning, itching of
legs ; worse, exposure to air. Exostosis. Scrofulo-
derma; syphilis, secondary eruption and later symptoms.
Valuable for intercurrent use.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, in afternoons, damp air, motion.
Better, in morning, dry air.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Staphis.; Mercur.; Syphil.;
Aur.; Corydalis (syphilitic nodes).
